'''Dirk Van den Abeele''' (born 23 July 1961) is a Flemish [[Ornithology|ornithologist]], specializing in the genus ''[[Lovebird|Agapornis]]''. He has written a number of books on this subject. Most of his books have been translated into English, Greek, Spanish, French, Czech, Italian and German.<ref>{{cite book|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=QPoyAAAACAAJ|title=Lovebirds: Handbook and Reference Guide|first=Dirk Van den|last=Abeele|date=28 November 2018|publisher=About Pets|via=Google Books|isbn=9781852792466}}</ref><ref>{{cite book|url=https://books.google.com/books?id=kIX5JnNioosC&q=agapornis+dirk+van+den+abelee|title=Agapornis|first=DIRK VAN|last=DEN|date=28 November 2018|publisher=Editorial HISPANO EUROPEA|via=Google Books|isbn=9788425516887}}</ref><ref>{{cite web | url=https://www.nieuwsblad.be/cnt/ghf124eu7 | title=Alles over dwergpapegaaien}}</ref><ref>{{cite web | url=http://www.parrotsdailynews.com/dirk-van-abeele-is-going-to-publish-his-most-extensive-monograph-about-lovebirds/ | title=Dirk van Abeele is going to publish his most extensive monograph about lovebirds| date=2016-02-02}}</ref><ref>{{cite web | url=http://www.grootwichelen.be/index.php/actualiteit/algemeen-nieuws/5506-tweede-versie-voor-dwergpapegaaienboek | title=Webnieuws Wichelen}}</ref> Since 1999, Van den Abeele is a  member of MUTAVI, Research & Advice Group in The Netherlands,<ref>{{cite web | url=http://www.mutavi.info | title=Www.MUTAVI.info}}</ref> where he is conducting research, together with Inte Onsman, into pigmentation of the various colour mutations in birds. Together with the Australian veterinarian Terry Martin he collaborated on the 'International Agreements for Naming Colour Mutations in Psittaciformes'.<ref>[https://www.ogvzw.org/downloads/ia-uk.pdf ''International Agreements for Naming Color Mutations in Psittaciformes'']</ref> He was chairman of BVA International, the Belgian Lovebird Society from 1999 till December 2010. Since 2011 he is honorary chairman of BVA-International.<ref>{{Cite web | url=https://www.agapornidenclub.be/eng/?page_id=142 | title=BVA International Honorary Members – BVA International}}</ref>

== Ornitho-Genetics VZW ==
In 2005 he founded Ornitho-Genetics VZW in Belgium. Ornitho-Genetics VZW is an independent non-profit organization which focuses mainly on genetics, evolution, taxonomy and the study and conservation of birds in their natural habitat.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://trendstop.knack.be/nl/detail/871402666/ornitho-genetics.aspx|title=ORNITHO-GENETICS VZW - BE 0871.402.666 - Serskamp|website=trendstop.knack.be}}</ref> To support this research the organization cooperates globally with experts, scientists and museums. The results are published in books, on the internet and in ornithology and scientific journals.<ref>{{cite journal|title=Plumage colour variations in the Agapornis genus: a review|first1=Henriette|last1=van der Zwan|first2=Carina|last2=Visser|first3= Rencia |last3=van der Sluis|date=1 March 2019|journal=Ostrich|volume=90|issue=1 |pages=1–10|doi=10.2989/00306525.2018.1540446|bibcode=2019Ostri..90....1V |s2cid=91625093|hdl=2263/71245|hdl-access=free}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal|last1=Neves|first1=Ana Carolina de Oliveira|last2=Galván|first2=Ismael|last3=Van den Abeele|first3=Dirk|date=2020|title=Impairment of mixed melanin-based pigmentation in parrots.|journal=J. Exp. Biol.|volume=223|issue=12|pages=jeb225912|doi=10.1242/jeb.225912|pmid=32393547|language=en|doi-access=free|url=http://journals.biologists.com/jeb/article-pdf/doi/10.1242/jeb.225912/1979979/jeb225912.pdf}}</ref>

== Fieldwork==
In 2009 he studied ''[[Rosy-faced lovebird|Agapornis roseicollis]]'' in Namibia and in 2010 and 2013 he volunteered for the Lovebird Research Project, a study into ''[[Lilian's lovebird|Agapornis lilianae]]'' in [[Liwonde National Park]] in [[Malawi]]. This research project was set up by Tiwonge Mzumara and Mike Perrin from the [[University of KwaZulu-Natal]] in South Africa <ref>{{cite thesis|url=http://ukzn-dspace.ukzn.ac.za/handle/10413/12244|title=The ecology and conservation biology of Lilian's lovebird Agapornis lilianae in Malawi.|first=Mzumara, Tiwonge|last=I.|date=13 July 2015|type=Thesis }}</ref><ref>{{cite journal|title=Distribution of Lilian's Lovebirds in Malawi|first1=Tiwonge I|last1=Mzumara|first2=Michael R|last2=Perrin|first3=Colleen T|last3=Downs|date=2 September 2014|journal=Ostrich|volume=85|issue=3|pages=267–272|doi=10.2989/00306525.2014.963187|bibcode=2014Ostri..85..267M |s2cid=84262933}}</ref>

== Agapornis genome study ==
In 2015, Van den Abeele became a supervisor for a doctoral study on the genome of the genus ''Agapornis'' at the [[University of Potchefstroom]], South Africa.They were the first to map the complete genome of ''Agapornis roseicollis''. <ref>{{cite web | url=https://genomestudy.ogvzw.org/who-we-are/ | title=Who we are – Agapornis Genome Study}}</ref><ref>{{Cite journal | doi=10.1080/10495398.2017.1367692| pmid=29035135|title = Draft de Novo Genome Sequence of Agapornis roseicollis for Application in Avian Breeding| journal=Animal Biotechnology| volume=29| issue=4| pages=241–246|year = 2018|last1 = Van Der Zwan|first1 = Henriëtte| last2=Van Der Westhuizen| first2=Francois| last3=Visser| first3=Carina| last4=Van Der Sluis| first4=Rencia| s2cid=9488082| hdl=2263/63058| url=https://repository.up.ac.za/bitstream/2263/63058/1/VanDerZwan_Draft_2018.pdf| hdl-access=free}}</ref> Since 2021, he works, together with H. van der Zwan from the [[University of Potchefstroom]], South Africa and S. Yung Wa Sin from the School of Biological Sciences at the University of Hong Kong, on a DNA study of color mutations within the genus ''Agapornis''. <ref>{{Cite journal | url=https://academic.oup.com/pnasnexus/article/3/3/pgae107/7627975|title = Convergent evolution of parrot plumage coloration | journal=PNAS Nexus| volume=3| issue=3| year = 2024 
}}</ref>
